name: charge
description: Level 2 (3.3 kW) charge from 40 %. The taper is the MODEL's, not a script: charge power holds flat to the knee (which sits near 69 % on this 35 %-SOH pack) and then rolls off smoothly toward zero at 100 %. Runs at REAL TIME (1x), like every shipped scenario bar degradation_arc: compress it yourself with --speed, or with the cockpit's Time card, so the clock is always one you chose (docs/SIMULATOR.md, 'Compressing time'). The charge takes about five hours at 1x; `--speed 120` puts it into two and a half minutes.
